title: Signed coherent pullback tensor exchange on K-flat representatives
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbb{Q}_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ and a morphism $f:X\to Y$. Use the coherent sequence modules, exact inverse image $F$ and normalized coherent tensor comparison $\mu$ of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations], the K-flat tensor models [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], and the signed derived braidings $\sigma_X,\sigma_Y$ of [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-braiding]. For any two unbounded K-flat complexes $P,Q$ of coefficient-sequence module sheaves on $Y$, put $M=Q_Y(P)$ and $N=Q_Y(Q)$. Then $F(\sigma_Y(M,N))\,\mu(N,M)=\mu(M,N)\,\sigma_X(FM,FN)$. No termwise flatness, boundedness, constructibility, or invertibility of $\ell$ is assumed. This is the representative calculation; the extension by naturality to all derived objects is separate.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product (the total tensor construction); More on Algebra, Tag 0FNG, section-sign-rules, item-flip-tensor-product.

proof.text: In each degree apply injectivity of the actual sequence-module adjunction Hom equivalence. Naturality of its unit moves the source signed exchange before that unit. Total-summand injections, tensor sheafification and pure-tensor extensionality reduce the two module maps to sections. Use the specified formulas for pullbackTensorSequenceCochain and pullbackTensorSignedTotal. All section maps preserve integer multiples, so both sections are (-1)^(p*q) times the tensor of the unit sections of y and x. This proves the signed chain square, for arbitrary unbounded P and Q.

Apply DerivedCategory.Q to this chain equality. Naturality of the exact-pullback factorization supplies its comparison with the derived inverse image. The K-flat preservation declaration gives target K-flat models. Insert the canonical comparison normalization on (P,Q) and (Q,P), and the signed braiding normalization on the source pair and the target pair. Cancel the invertible source tensor representative and target tensor of factorization maps. Naturality of the target braiding gives the desired representative equation.

proof_origin.place: Explicit adjunction-unit and signed-generator calculation from Tag 07A4 and the sign convention of Tag 0FNG, followed by categorical cancellation of the fixed K-flat models.

theorem completedPullbackTensor_signed_representatives {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (P Q : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (J := coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
      (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) P)
    (hQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (J := coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
      (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) Q) :
    let M := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
    let N := DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q
    (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).map
      ((pullbackTensorBraiding (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
        (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y)
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemTensorModel).hom.app (M,N)) ≫
      (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app (N,M) =
    (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app (M,N) ≫
      (pullbackTensorBraiding (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology X))
        (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E X)
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemTensorModel).hom.app
          ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj M,
            (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj N)
